biography.content:
Architectural historian and a historic preservationist specializing in the western Mediterranean and Portuguese-speaking world in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries. My research explores the interfaces between traditional and modern construction as well as between the learned architecture of classicism and vernacular typologies.

Associate professor at the University of Brasilia School of Architecture and Urbanism and member of the Documentation committee of Icomos Brazil. Consulting work in historic preservation and traditional architecture through Ábaco Arquitetura.
